stem:
Felicia earns $800 a month. The table shows her monthly budget.

Monthly Budget

| Expense        | Amount of Money |
|----------------|----------------|
| College savings| $200           |
| Car payment    | $275           |
| Cell phone     | $125           |
| Clothes        | $50            |
| Food           | $100           |
| Other          | $50            |

Which statement is supported by the information in the table?

options.label: A
options.text: Felicia spends 10% of her monthly budget on clothes and food.

options.label: B
options.text: Felicia spends 25% of her monthly budget on her car payment.

options.label: C
options.text: Felicia spends 20% of her monthly budget on college savings.

options.label: D
options.text: Felicia spends 50% of her monthly budget on her car payment and cell phone.

visual_elements: Table showing Monthly Budget with two columns: Expense and Amount of Money. Rows: College savings $200, Car payment $275, Cell phone $125, Clothes $50, Food $100, Other $50.
